page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence and relying entirely on CPU-based processing. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between instances and external services. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this configuration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7.32xlarge offers a high-density deployment option for workloads requiring significant parallel processing capabilities without the overhead of specialized hardware. The balanced resource allocation makes it suitable for enterprise applications, large-scale web serving, containerized microservices, and general-purpose workloads that demand substantial compute and memory capacity in a unified environment.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is a general-purpose server instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at 2.7 GHz, paired with 512.0 GB of system memory. This configuration establishes a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached volumes. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps. Designed for high-density deployments, this instance is suitable for enterprise applications, large-scale web serving, and containerized environments that require substantial parallel processing capabilities and balanced memory resources without specialized acceleration.
